title: Element
description: An Element is a leaf UI primitive within a Component (e.g. an input, button, or label). It optionally binds to a Field on the Component's Resource.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the element.

type.description: The structural type of the element.

description.description: A human-readable explanation of what this element does.

field.description: The Field on the parent Component's Resource that this element binds to.
